Welcome, visitor. [ / Log in ] Meru Capital Group LP Has Upped Apple (AAPL) Stake by $3.47 Million as Stock Rose; As Wynn Resorts LTD (WYNN) Market Valuation Rose, Tiger Legatus Capital Management Has Decreased Its Stake by $1.48 Million 
March 18, 2018 - By Adrian Mccoy 
Guru Ramakrishnan increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 225%   Meru Capital Group Lp bought 22,500 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The hedge fund run by Guru Ramakrishnan held 32,500 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $5.01 million, up from 10,000   Meru Capital Group Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $903.28 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.35% or $0.63   $178.02. About 39.40M shares traded or 10.09% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48%   outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
Jesse Ro decreased its stake in Wynn Resorts Ltd (WYNN) by 20%   Tiger Legatus Capital Management Llc sold 10,000 shares as the company’s stock rose 26.92% with the market. The hedge fund run by Jesse Ro held 40,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $5.96 million, down from 50,000   Tiger Legatus Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Wynn Resorts Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $19.03 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.78% or $1.45   $184.76. About 2.03 million shares traded. Wynn Resorts, Limited (NASDAQ:WYNN) has risen 37.63%   outperformed by 20.93% the S&P500. 
Among 53 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 34 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 64% are positive. Apple Inc. had 385 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. As per Monday, February 27, the company rating was maintained by Mizuho. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Overweight” rating given on Wednesday, April 27 by Barclays Capital. BTIG Research maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Thursday, September 15 report. Stifel Nicolaus maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) on Wednesday, December 23 with “Buy” rating. The stock of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Buy” rating given on Monday, October 23 by UBS. The company was maintained on Wednesday, August 2 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. Longbow downgraded the shares of AAPL in report on Wednesday, January 17 to “Neutral” rating. Canaccord Genuity maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Friday, February 2. Canaccord Genuity has “Buy” rating and $200.0 target. Nomura maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Thursday, September 22 with “Buy” rating. The company was maintained on Tuesday, August 25 by Global Equities Research. 
Investors sentiment increased to 0.7 in Q3 2017. Its up 0.02, from 0.68 in 2017Q2. It is positive, as 52 investors sold AAPL shares while 1034 reduced holdings. 116 funds opened positions while 640 raised stakes. 2.97 billion shares or 2.78% less from 3.06 billion shares in 2017Q2 were reported. Moreover, Boyar Asset Mgmt Inc has 0.2% invested in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Meristem Limited Liability Partnership holds 1.36% or 21,917 shares in its portfolio. 12Th Street Asset Mngmt Ltd Liability Corp stated it has 138,361 shares or 5.52% of all its holdings. Marshwinds Advisory Communications holds 1,890 shares. Alesco Advsrs Ltd Liability, New York-based fund reported 5,954 shares. Laurel Grove Limited Liability Corp reported 4.23% stake. Monarch Cap Mngmt Inc holds 1.17% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) for 20,386 shares. Miles Cap reported 12,816 shares or 1.12% of all its holdings. Mercer Advisers reported 39,902 shares or 4.56% of all its holdings. Glenview Capital Management Limited Liability Corporation reported 2.49M shares. Holderness Investments Communications owns 30,467 shares. Global Endowment Management LP stated it has 0.07% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Schwartz Invest Counsel Inc accumulated 3,330 shares or 0.03% of the stock. Grantham Mayo Van Otterloo Communication Lc stated it has 3.83% of its portfolio in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL). Palo Cap accumulated 27,469 shares or 2.24% of the stock. 
Since October 3, 2017, it had 0 insider buys, and 5 selling transactions for $26.38 million activity. $8.79M worth of stock was sold by SCHILLER PHILIP W on Tuesday, October 3. $9.78 million worth of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was sold by AHRENDTS ANGELA J on Tuesday, October 3. 
Among 29 analysts covering Wynn Resorts ( NASDAQ:WYNN ), 15 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 13 Hold. Therefore 52% are positive. Wynn Resorts had 88 analyst reports since July 31, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Roth Capital downgraded the stock to “Hold” rating in Wednesday, February 7 report. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Friday, July 14 by Stifel Nicolaus. Stifel Nicolaus maintained the stock with “Hold” rating in Wednesday, February 7 report. The firm earned “Hold” rating on Monday, January 29 by Nomura. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Friday, October 27 by Stifel Nicolaus. The stock has “Outperform” rating by CLSA on Friday, April 29. The rating was downgraded by Union Gaming to “Hold” on Wednesday, July 26. Morgan Stanley downgraded the shares of WYNN in report on Friday, February 9 to “Equal-Weight” rating. The stock of Wynn Resorts, Limited (NASDAQ:WYNN) has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, January 23 by Stifel Nicolaus. The rating was upgraded by JP Morgan on Wednesday, February 7 to “Overweight”. 
Analysts await Wynn Resorts, Limited (NASDAQ:WYNN) to report earnings on April, 24. They expect $1.85 earnings per share, up 49.19% or $0.61 from last year’s $1.24 per share. WYNN’s profit will be $190.59 million for 24.97 P/E if the $1.85 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.40 actual earnings per share reported by Wynn Resorts, Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 32.14% EPS growth. -   Adrian Mccoy
